rendering: Holds rendering metadata for reporting items; grain = one row per (submission_number, report, file_type, shortname) rendering configuration; notable columns/keys = submission_number, report, file_type, menu_category, shortname, longname, roleuri, parentroleuri, parentreport, ultimate_parent_report, PARTITION.
numbers: Holds numeric facts extracted from submissions; grain = one row per numeric fact instance (submission_number, measure_tag, version, period_end_date, iprx); notable columns/keys = submission_number, company_name, measure_tag, version, period_end_date, number_of_quarters, units, dimension_hash, iprx, value, footnote, footnote_length, num_dimensions, coregistrant, duration_fraction, date_fraction, decimal, PARTITION.
sic_codes: Lookup of SIC code metadata; grain = one row per SIC code; notable columns/keys = sic_code, ad_office, industry_title.
presentation: Holds presentation tree ordering and labels for reported items; grain = one row per presentation line (submission_number, report, line, measure_tag); notable columns/keys = submission_number, report, line, statement, presented_parenthetically, rfile, measure_tag, version, preferred_role, preferred_label, negating, PARTITION.
dimension: Stores dimension segment contents keyed by hash; grain = one row per segments_hash (dimension combination); notable columns/keys = segments_hash, segments, segment_truncation, PARTITION.
measure_tag: Catalog of measure tags (concept metadata); grain = one row per (measure_tag, version); notable columns/keys = measure_tag, version, custom, abstract, datatype, i_or_d, credit_or_debit, tag_label, doc, PARTITION.
quick_summary: Precomputed summary facts and filing metadata for a submission-concept-period; grain = one row per (submission_number, measure_tag, period_end_date, version); notable columns/keys = submission_number, company_name, measure_tag, period_end_date, value, units, number_of_quarters, version, central_index_key, ein, sic, fiscal_year_end, form, fiscal_year, fiscal_period_focus, date_filed, date_accepted, PARTITION.
calculation: Calculation relationships between tags in a submission; grain = one row per calculation arc (submission_number, group, parent_tag, child_tag, arc); notable columns/keys = submission_number, group, arc, negative, parent_tag, parent_version, child_tag, child_version, PARTITION.
submission: Holds filing-level metadata for each submission; grain = one row per submission (submission_number); notable columns/keys = submission_number, central_index_key, company_name, sic, countryba, stprba, cityba, zipba, ba_street1, ba_street2, ba_phone, countryma, stprma, cityma, zipma, ma_street1, ma_street2, country_inc, state_province_inc, ein, former_name, date_changed, filer_status, well_known_seasoned_issuer, fiscal_year_end, form, period, fiscal_year, fiscal_period_focus, date_filed, date_accepted, has_previous_report, has_required_detail, instance, num_ciks, additional_ciks, public_float_usd, float_date, float_axis, float_terms.
txt: Holds text/string facts and contexts from submissions; grain = one row per text fact instance (submission_number, measure_tag, version, period_end_date, iprx); notable columns/keys = submission_number, measure_tag, version, period_end_date, num_quarters, iprx, language, language_decimal, duration_fraction, date_fraction, dimension_hash, num_dimensions, coregistrant, escaped, source_length, text_length, footnote, footnote_length, context, value, PARTITION.
